description: Evidencija telekomunikacijskih ormarića Digitalnog grada is a dataset listed in DATA - City of Zagreb, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by data.zagreb.hr. Records of Digital City telecommunication cabinets. Coverage: HR. The portal shows the English title as "Records of Digital City telecommunication cabinets" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include telekomunikacijski ormarići, digitalni grad. The listing shows 2 download or service links in XLSX, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://data.gov.hr/otvorena-dozvola). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-grad-zagreb.
